allowed_claims: On one 40-frame AIMD-300 K Cu validation trajectory, the final fixed-epoch adapted models degraded force accuracy for all three optimizer seeds.
The adapted mean-prediction ensemble increased force-component MAE by 86.11 percent and force-vector P95 by 88.88 percent relative to zero shot.
The original pool-wide median disagreement gate was misaligned with the top-36 selection window in this heterogeneous pool.
The gate amendment was recorded before any pool label reveal.
prohibited_claims: Any active-learning arm improved or degraded performance.
The tail-risk policy is superior or inferior.
The preregistered hypothesis was accepted or rejected.
A frozen-test, stress-test, VESSL, or cross-provider result exists.
The finding generalizes to copper, MACE, or foundation MLIPs as a population.
